description: forever-dash fork: follow only upstream Polestar's addon releases (overlay/upstream.txt). Upstream's own dependencies are upstream's business, so every other manager is off.

customManagers.description: Upstream Polestar's addon release. Its repository also tags client-v*, lib-v*, forge-v* and data releases: only vX.Y.Z is an addon release.

packageRules.description: Merge on a branch, no pull request: upstream's PR workflows (pr-base wants PRs to go to next; ci runs their whole suite) don't belong to this fork. The branch push runs the release workflow as a check (build, no publish); the merge to dash publishes.
